Thus, the STWM, as one of the most sensitive models of escalation potential of territorial disputes, confirms confrontational behaviour in two indicators, militarisation and coalition-building. The latter, however, changed dramatically after February 2022. Regional Arctic coalitions have suspended most forms of cooperation with Russia, and two of the regional actors, Finland and Sweden, applied for NATO membership in May 2022 with Finland joining in April 2023 and Sweden’s membership awaiting Turkish ratification as of November 2023.
